subject: Renewal + Capacity: exec readout & stakeholder calendar poll
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@averysys.com>, renewals@averysys.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + Capacity: exec readout & stakeholder calendar poll

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we discussed on the call, we'd like to start a short renewal coordination track so we have alignment on term/commit options and expected capacity growth ahead of your Jan 15 renewal date. Key asks on our side:

- Lock a 30–45m exec readout (your exec + our AE/CS leadership) the week of Dec 13–17
- Confirm stakeholder list (billing/finance, security/compliance, platform ops) so we can invite the right Redwoods
- Send over any updated traffic forecasts by Dec 10 so we can finalize capacity recommendations

I've put a quick calendar poll below that includes the week-of windows; please vote for three slots that work. I'll follow up with an agenda and a short MOP (attached) that outlines commit vs burst options and the runbook for a seamless term change.

Attachments: Avery_Renewal_MOP_v1.pdf (summary of term options), capacity-forecast.csv (sample template)

Next steps:
1) Vote on the poll — Calendly link at the bottom.
2) Send traffic forecast by end of day Dec 10.
3) Confirm exec readout attendees and billing contact.

Thanks —
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
https://redwood.com
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@averysys.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: renewals@averysys.com, priya.rao@averysys.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal + Capacity: exec readout & stakeholder calendar poll

Chloe —

Thanks for the clear rundown. We can do the week of Dec 13; Priya and I penciled in Dec 15 (morning PST) as our preferred time but we'll vote on the poll.

Quick answers:
- I'll pull the updated traffic forecast and send it by EOD Dec 9 (timezone note: we operate PST for the product team).
- Exec readout attendees: me (VP Product), Priya Rao (Head of Platform), and our CFO (Beth Gardner) — Beth asked to receive a pre-read 24 hours beforehand.
- Billing contact: renewals@averysys.com (cc'd).

One ask from our side: will Redwood include a short section in the pre-read that calls out the risk profile if we move to a shorter term + burst vs a committed uplift? Beth wants a clear cost delta and SLA implications.

Appreciate it — Sam
Sam Patel
VP Product, Avery Systems
sam.patel@averysys.com | +1 (617) 555-0110
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + Capacity: exec readout & stakeholder calendar poll

Chloe / team —

Thanks for looping us in. A few operational notes ahead of the exec readout:

- I'll prepare a 5-slide runbook that maps commit sizes to throughput and expected p50/p95 latencies per model class. That will include cost deltas for 6-month vs 12-month term lengths.
- Ben: can you include the standard SLA uplift language and a short note on fallbacks (region routing / model variant) in the pre-read?
- Laura: please confirm if Legal should be on the call or just looped for the contract redline afterwards. If Beth wants a pre-read, we should get the doc to her by Dec 14 COB.

Also recommending we include a one-page matrix in the pre-read labeled 'Operational Risk' that lists likely runtime impacts and mitigations for each option — Sam asked for this explicitly, and Beth will want speed to resolution.

I'll take the draft runbook and the matrix; Chloe, if you share the draft MOP you attached I'll iterate and get a version to Sam by Dec 13.

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Reliability, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Sam / Priya —

Great — confirmed: Dec 15, 10:00 AM PST (30m) for an exec readout. Calendar invites going out now.

Per items above, next steps from Redwood:
- Marcus will share the runbook + operational-risk matrix by EOD Dec 13.
- Ben will draft the SLA uplift language and fallback summary (legal to review).
- I'll send a short pre-read (1 pager + MOP summary) to Beth and Priya by Dec 14 morning.

Action items for Avery:
- Send traffic forecast (capacity-forecast.csv filled) by EOD Dec 9 — Sam confirmed.
- Confirm any additional attendees for the exec readout so we can include them on the invite.

Calendar poll / schedule: https://calendly.com/chloem-renewal/30min
Pre-read attached and uploaded to drive: https://redwood.app/drive/record/DW-4448

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the readout.
